## The claim

No single route carries the fused result: removing any one admitted ranking route leaves the fused rank-1 pair unchanged.

**Prediction if true.** In the leave-one-route-out table, every single-route removal reproduces the same rank-1 pair as the all-routes fusion.

**What would refute it.** Any single-route removal changes which pair holds fused rank 1.

| 96 | supports | 0.40 | measurement | Silencing the knowledge route leaves the leader at rank 1 unchanged, and silencing the phenotype route leaves it at rank 1 tied with a decoy gene. | `methodology/108` |
| 97 | supports | 0.35 | measurement | Re-weighting every route by its own measured error rate leaves the leader at rank 1, so the rank-1 result is not an artefact of equal weights. | `methodology/108` |
